title: ARTEX-Associated Microsoft Graph Activity

1.json:
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where IPAddress in ("199.19.77.84")
| project TimeGenerated, IPAddress, AppId, ServicePrincipalId, RequestMethod, RequestUri, ResponseStatusCode
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
